protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. The -s option assigns attacker-controlled optarg (or optarg + 5) to siodev, main passes siodev to devopen(), and devopen() appends it with unbounded strcat() into char t[1024]. The cited ASan PoC supplies 3000 bytes and reports the overflow at tapslip6.c:420. CVE.org currently records CVE-2026-22213 as PUBLISHED and affected through 2026.01-devel-317.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed. git log --follow --diff-filter=A and git log -L identify 1a146f7934d02324361b90980243286b3db432e3 as the first RIOT commit containing tapslip6.c and the vulnerable devopen() body. It is the smallest surviving public-history object that first writes the vulnerable lines, not a later move, refactor, revert, merge, or release commit.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed. The BIC has the single immediate parent d2fea78e76e48a841bdf024167e410fada603d33; parent:path lookup fails because dist/tools/tunslip/tapslip6.c is absent, while the BIC creates that file and writes the complete source-to-sink path.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: Confirmed not applicable. The BIC is a single-parent six-file Contiki import, not a merge or squash aggregate with separately reconstructible RIOT member commits; no finer public RIOT commit precedes its first-write of tapslip6.c.
protocol_checks.affected_release_membership: Confirmed. 1a146f7934d02324361b90980243286b3db432e3 is an ancestor of 2015.09, 2025.10, the 2026.01-devel tag, and advisory upper-bound commit 66a6eab99779d46aa851eb81fa6f786b91b921b8. At that upper bound, described as 2026.01-devel-317-g66a6eab997, devopen() still has the unbounded strcpy()/strcat() pair and the fix is not an ancestor.
protocol_checks.fixed_release_membership: Confirmed. Direct fix 30791dbd8d360f8cb76b1aed17c68f375dbf4a41 is merged by 6e06b384233db31fd99b3b8b567f3b8d34aea0c7 and is an ancestor of tag 2026.01 and later listed release tags; it is not an ancestor of 2025.10 or the 2026.01-devel tag.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: Confirmed direct fix. 30791dbd8d360f8cb76b1aed17c68f375dbf4a41 computes strlen(dev), rejects lengths at or above sizeof(t) - strlen("/dev/") with EINVAL, and only then executes the existing concatenation. The landing merge has parents 66a6eab99779d46aa851eb81fa6f786b91b921b8 and 30791dbd8d360f8cb76b1aed17c68f375dbf4a41.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: Confirmed. The BIC commit object is a 2015 commit authored and committed by Martine Lenders with only subject 'tools: import tunslip from contiki'; it has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI marker. Later fix-era material is not used for introducer attribution, so NOT_AI is supported from the BIC alone.
